notes.title: Patch 4 Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Patch 4 Notes[/b]

[u]Fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed key mapping not saving correctly.
[*] Fixed volume settings not saving correctly.
[*] Reduced block reset timer.
[/list]

notes.title: Hotfix 1 Notes
notes.notes:
Hotfix 1 Notes

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed vulnerability bugs introduced for Chase and Rollo by Patch 3.
[/list]

notes.title: Patch 3 Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Patch 3 Notes[/b]

[u]Fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Fixed instances where player punches look like they should have connected, but do not do damage or stagger the opponent
[*] Tweaked some reaction behavior of Zeke
[*] Fixed timer in the vtuber mini-game not displaying correctly
[*] Added background music to the Arcade Mode menu
[/list]

notes.title: Release Day Patch 2 Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Release Day Patch 2 Notes[/b]

Fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed a loop where the game would load back to the main menu when pressing play after completing the main game. The game will now load the player to before starting the end sequence.
[/list]

notes.title: Release Day Patch 1 Notes
notes.notes:
[b]Release Day Patch 1 Notes[/b]

[u]Fixes:[/u]
[list]
[*] Updated Arcade mode (unlocked after completing the main game) to allow for replaying individual fights.
[*] Tweaks to Arcade mode menu
[*] Fixed some text clipping for instruction screens and fighter card screens
[/list]

notes.title: Bare Knuckle Sandwich is RELEASED (10% Launch discount!!)
notes.notes:
Bare Knuckle Sandwich is [b]OUT[/b] and ready for you. 

Pick it up now while the 10% launch discount is happening!

Bare Knuckle Sandwich is a 2D boxing game featuring side-scrolling storytelling and a character driven narrative. Follow Gunner as he joins an underground bare-knuckle boxing ring looking for something to strive for in a world full of con-artists, grifters, and people just trying to get by. After meeting a new mentor, Gunner begins to find his footing after a rough start to adulthood. However, it's a long way to the top and he'll have to overcome everyone standing in his way to succeed, especially himself.

Key Features:
[list]
[*] Punch-Out style boxing against an eccentric cast of 8 opponents.
[*] 2D side scrolling storytelling and interactions with city denizens.
[*] Mini-games to earn extra cash.
[*] Browse the pawn shop to pick up new clothes and items to customize your Gunner and his apartment.
[/list]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44306122/b8b25abea653eae1efeed32391350b23b6d32d5f.jpg[/img]
